api.chart: echarts.init(null, null, {renderer: 'svg', ssr: true, width, height}); chart._ssr = false
api.export: chart.getConnectedDataURL(opts) with getDom().getBoundingClientRect and renderToCanvas stubbed per chart and setPlatformAPI({createCanvas}) a recording canvas

notes: Pointer steps: zrender Handler mousemove / globalout; a frame after every step.
Every chart listens to every connect-able event type plus selectchanged, axisbreakchanged and updated (rendered / finished are frames, not actions).

Upstream registers the forwarder of a published event before the connect listener (_initEvents runs in the constructor, enableConnect after init): a chart's own handlers hear an event before the charts of its group are sent the action.

link.note: grid-multiple: two grids stacked, category x, link as an OBJECT {xAxisIndex: all} (the preprocessor wraps it)
three grids side by side, value x axes with ids a / b / c; [{xAxisId: [a, b], mapper: @Double}]: a pointer in a puts b at twice the value and back; c is on its own

by axis NAME and the first group that matches: [{xAxisName: left}, {xAxisName: [right, left], mapper: @Shift}] -- left is taken by group 0, so group 1 holds right alone and nothing links; [{xAxisIndex: [0, 2]} ...] in the next case
by name with a category mapper: [{xAxisName: [left, right], mapper: @Shift}] -- the target is one category on; past the last one there is no pointer
tooltip cross: x linked by index, y linked with @Half (the cross arm: no tooltip, no snap, the pointer at the mapped value)
a snapping value source passes its SNAPPED value on, the target does not snap; @Hundred maps out of the target extent: no pointer there

two x axes in one grid (bottom a..e; top p, q, r with max 4: positions 3 and 4 hold no category), linked with @Half: at b both show and nothing is linked; at e and d the top one shows nothing and takes half the bottom one's value, parsed (2, and 1.5 -> 2)
two shown axes of one group in grid 0 (the bottom x at b, 1; the top x of three categories at p, 0) and a target in grid 1: the target takes the LAST source's value

a polar over the grid holds the point too: the grid's top x shows nothing and is linked from its bottom x (d, 3 -> @Half 1.5 -> r) -- its pointer joins the grid's axes in the tooltip, before the polar's
no link: a value axis cut at 10 snaps only to a point that is on it -- nearest 9 is 12, past the axis, so the pointer stays at 9 (the tooltip still names 12); nearest 3 is 2

connect.note: two charts of one shape in group g: what A does B follows; B's own events do not come back; escapeConnect, a silent dispatch and disconnect stop it; connect([A, B]) keeps g
three charts: B's action reaches A and C (each once); C moved to group h stops hearing g; a chart with no group hears nothing
a wheel on A's inside dataZoom: the batched dataZoom action (its animation in every item) and B following

timelineChange and timelinePlayChange between two timeline charts, with the brushSelect their updates dispatch (milestone D5-D8: it was left out, dropBrushSelect, while the port ran the update of a merged frame at the next frame)
B has no legend and one dataZoom: A's legend action reaches a chart with no legend (an empty map), A's dataZoom on index 1 finds no dataZoom in B

batch.note: a brush whose option writes its style (the colours echoed as written) and action areas with keys of their own: generateBrushOption overwrites the six in place, the rest follow in order, then range and a targeted panelId (milestone D5-D8)
a resize is an update with a payload ({type: 'resize'}): the brush visual dispatches brushSelect -- brushselected, which B is sent -- then `updated` (milestone D5-D8)
the legend actions with a batch: each item over the payload, ONE update, one event whose batch holds each item's own result
select / toggleSelect / unselect with a batch: the event batch repeats the FIRST item (refineEvent keeps eventObj), selectchanged once with the outer payload
highlight / downplay batches: escapeConnect rides on the event
dataZoom batches: by index, by id, the outer animation in every item; a silent one publishes nothing
a batch in a connected group: B is sent the batched event as an action (each item keeps the event's type and result keys)

expandAxisBreak (a refined action) batched in a connected group: its non-refined batch event goes to connect only, every item a copy of the FIRST item (refineEvent keeps eventObj) -- so B is sent the first break twice and expands only that one; collapseAxisBreak back the same way

exportCases.note: three charts in a row with gaps, no options: the dpr is the asking chart's (1 here)
pixelRatio 1.5 with odd offsets: fractional positions, the canvas size as the raw product
overlapping charts at negative offsets; jpeg; backgroundColor goes to each chart's own render
connectedBackgroundColor 'none' is still a rect fill (zrender: no fill)
pixelRatio 1.1: the left edge times the ratio is inexact, each offset the product less it (milestone D5-D8)
the group is set but never connected: getDataURL of the asking chart alone

guards.what: the bottom grid follows the top one
one highlight batch for both grids
b follows a through the mapper
left belongs to group 0 alone: nothing follows
one category on from the last: no target
the target takes the source's snapped 4.5
B toggles s2 as A did
A's own handler before B hears anything
B's event is not sent back to A
a silent dispatch publishes nothing, so nothing is broadcast
B hears its own brushselected and A's echo
C in h hears nothing of g
the select batch repeats the first item
B is sent the first item twice (refineEvent keeps eventObj)
